item.title: DeepCybo PhysBrain 1.5 Posts 72.5 on 28 Benchmarks as Open Physical Foundation Model
item.description: DeepCybo open-sources PhysBrain 1.5 (2B/8B): 72.5 average across 28 public embodied benchmarks, claimed open-source lead, with unified understanding, action, and future-state tokens plus an eval kit.

item.title: Infinigence AI Open-Sources APXInf for Embodied Edge Inference on Jetson Thor
item.description: Infinigence AI open-sources APXInf with Tsinghua and SJTU: PI 0.5 FP8 on Jetson Thor drops end-to-end latency from ~278 ms to ~26 ms (~38.46 Hz), with Orin/Thor/RTX 4090 support and a domestic-chip roadmap.

item.title: Huawei Maps Intelligent World 2035 Around Agent Token Traffic and Ten Tech Directions
item.description: Huawei's Intelligent World 2035 and GDII 2026 forecast agents above 90% of AI token traffic by 2035 and roughly 900 billion agents, with ten infra directions from SuperPoD and Tau Scaling to Agent OS and agent security.

item.title: CXMT HBM Yield Near 25% as YMTC XStacking Hybrid Bond Enters DRAM Stack Plans
item.description: KSIA-cited gaps put China about 3 years behind Korea on HBM, 2 on DRAM, 1 on NAND; CXMT LPDDR6 is in volume while HBM trial yield ~25%, with a YMTC XStacking Cu–Cu hybrid-bond DRAM stack plan.

item.title: Tencent Open-Sources WeKnora With Official DeepSeek Harness Plugin
item.description: Tencent WeChat open-sources WeKnora, a RAG-to-agent knowledge platform with 25k+ GitHub stars, plus an official DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds four read-only retrieval tools for enterprise documents.
